title: 9 Best Herbal Tinctures For Bladder Pain
description: Vaccinium macrocarpon tinctures, also known as cranberry tinctures, have been traditionally used to treat bladder pain ailments such as urinary tract infections (UTIs) and interstitial cystitis. The astringent and anti-inflammatory properties of Vaccinium macrocarpon help to soothe and calm the bladder, reducing pain and discomfort.
